Definition:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme NTBLCP/TB 04 TB Laboratory Register for Xpert MTB/RIF assay,
AFB microscopy and other TB diagnostic tests. One model instance represents
a laboratory register and contains repeatable laboratory entries corresponding
to individual patient/specimen rows in the source register.
Identifier assigned to the TB laboratory register or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the laboratory maintaining the register, when available.
Name of the laboratory maintaining the NTBLCP/TB 04 register.
Local Government Area in which the laboratory is located.
One patient/specimen row in the NTBLCP/TB 04 TB Laboratory Register.

Definition: Reference to the corresponding Nigeria Core Patient resource, when available.
Laboratory-assigned serial number for the specimen or examination.
Specimen identification number recorded on the laboratory register.
Date the specimen was received in the laboratory.
Constraint(s): Date specimen was received in the lab

Definition: True when the specimen was accepted by the laboratory; false when rejected.
Reason for specimen rejection when specimenAccepted is false.
Name of the patient as recorded in the laboratory register.
Patient sex. The source register records M or F.
Constraint(s): Patient Data: Sex (insert M or F)

Definition: Patient age recorded in the laboratory register.
Patient address recorded in the laboratory register.
Reference to the facility from which the patient or specimen was referred, when available.
Name of the facility from which the patient or specimen was referred.
Type of presumptive TB recorded in the source register. Expected source values are DS-TB or DR-TB.
Constraint(s): Patient Data: Type of Presumptive - DS-TB / DR-TB

Definition: Site of TB disease. Expected source values are Pulmonary or Extra-Pulmonary.
Constraint(s): Patient Data: Site of Disease - Pulmonary / Extra-Pulmonary

Definition: Indicates whether the patient is a health care worker.
Constraint(s): Patient Data: Health care worker (Indicate Y/N)

Definition: HIV status known before presentation to the laboratory. Expected source values are Positive, Negative or Unknown.
Constraint(s): HIV Status: Previously Known HIV status - Positive / Negative / Unknown

Short: Tested for HIV in the laboratory
Definition: HIV testing status/result recorded by the laboratory. Expected source values are Positive, Negative or Not tested.
Constraint(s): HIV Status: Tested for HIV in the lab - Positive / Negative / Not tested

Definition: Type of specimen submitted to the laboratory, for example sputum or another clinical specimen.
Laboratory test requested for the specimen.
Constraint(s): Specimen Information: Type of Test Required (Specify test)

Definition: Results of Xpert MTB/RIF testing when performed.
